description.fallback: Boruto dreams of Momoshiki's warning to him, and looks at the mark on his hand when he wakes up, wondering why he dreamt of it after all this time. While on a mission, Boruto thinks back to Sasuke's recommendations about the mark. Team 7 pursues bank robbers, but Boruto knocks out the one who was supposed to get away, leading them to their leader.
